services.desc: Events are our specialty and we have just the right ambience no matter the occasion. In fact, any kind of event that involves people getting together whether it be for a fundraising gala dinner, business meeting or a party “just for fun” our team of event experts will make sure every detail is in place for your special event. Rehearsal dinners, Bar/Bat Mitzvahs, Birthday Parties, Anniversary Celebrations, the Club is the perfect place to host your special event. Catering to all palates from young to the gourmet we can customize menus and themes to compliment your specific gathering.
